text:
lee: Quick flag 1.2% BLEU drop on longdoc-structured slice when rolling v3.1-int4 into shadow. Not huge but consistent across seeds.

sam: Is BLEU our main fidelity metric for that slice? any EM or schema-violation increases?

lee: We look at BLEU + schema-parse-fail rate. Schema fails jumped 0.9pp (from 1.1% -> 2.0%). BLEU delta 1.2 (relative ~3.5%). Seeded shadow window = 18k queries.

maria: Which parts of the schema? field ordering, missing fields, or type mismatches?

lee: Mostly missing optional fields in nested sections and more length-truncation on the last field. Also more top-k entropy in last-token.

devon: Could be tail KV eviction or quant-induced softmax smoothing. Any head-level diffs?

lee: I ran a quick KL per-head on attention outputs; heads 5 and 12 show elevated KL (~0.03), rest minimal.

sam: Do we have an A/B comparison across sources? longdoc comes from both internal crawl and customer uploads; maybe one source is skewing.

lee: Split results: internal crawl shows 1.0 BLEU drop, customer uploads 1.6 drop. Both show schema fails uptick.

maria: Ramp status? Did this reach canary pool or stayed in shadow?

deploy-bot: deployment: v3.1-int4 in shadow; canary 0% (no ramp). Automated shadow window completed at 18k queries.

sam: Good that canary didn't go live. What's our auto-fallback policy for structured-output slices? I remember a two-metric rule (schema fails OR BLEU).

lee: Current gatebook snippet: "auto-fallback if schema_fail_delta >= 0.5pp AND BLEU abs_delta >= 1.0 on N>=10k with p<0.01". We're meeting both but p-value borderline (~0.012) for some splits.

devon: I'd prefer to run a targeted 50k seeded run with customer-upload heavy weighting to confirm. Also run a warmstart test with KV prefix caching on for int4 path.

maria: Agreed. Run the 50k seeded (40% customer weight). Lee, can you kick it off and attach the run id? Sam, can you prepare an sql snippet we use for delta/pval?

sam: Pasting quick eval query:
```
SELECT slice, source, SUM((pred = expected)::int) as correct, COUNT(*) as n
FROM structured_eval
WHERE model in ('v3.0','v3.1') AND slice = 'longdoc-struct'
GROUP BY slice, source;
-- bootstrap pval across paired samples in analysis.py
```

lee: Started seeded job ID=seed-1713350001 on kubernetes batch. ETA ~3.5h. Pushing attention dumps to s3://eval-artifacts/v3.1/seed-1713350001.

maria: Till results are in, let's add holds: do not promote v3.1-int4 to canary pools, pin any in-flight rollouts. ops-bot?

ops-bot: @maria holds applied. Promotion blocked for v3.1-int4 across regions. Notifying release owners.

quant-bot: FYI: quick quant-report shows layernorm scaling differences in residual path for layers 8..12 on v3.1-int4. Recommend checking dynamic range clamping.

devon: That aligns with heads 5/12 KLs. Could be scale mismatch that only shows up after long prefix accumulation.

sam: When seeded run completes, metric requirements for auto-action: if seeded BLEU abs_delta >= 1.0 AND schema_fail p<0.005 on N>=20k -> auto-soft-rollback. Should we tighten p-value to 0.005 for structured slices?

maria: I support tightening for schema-sensitive slices. Add to gatebook PR if seeded run confirms.

lee: Seeded run finished: n=52,300 (customer-weighted). Results: BLEU v3.0=34.8 vs v3.1=33.5 (abs delta 1.3, p=0.0007). Schema fail rate v3.0=1.05% vs v3.1=2.45% (abs delta 1.4pp, p<1e-4). Head KL confirms elevated KL in earlier report.

devon: Solid signal. Recommend soft rollback and open ticket for quant team to iterate on scale/clamp. Also add KV warmstart experiment in the reproducer.

maria: Agreed. Lee, please create regression ticket and request rollback. Also attach s3 artifacts.

lee: Ticket ML-4299 created with artifacts: s3://eval-artifacts/v3.1/seed-1713350001/* . Requesting rollback.

ops-bot: Rolling back plan B: demote v3.1-int4 shadow -> v3.0 baseline in eval pools and block further promotions. ETA ~4 minutes.

deploy-bot: rollback submitted (#RB-1713350001). Canary remains at v3.0.

sam: Follow-ups for gatebook: 1) tighten structured-slice p-value to 0.005 and N>=20k, 2) add per-head KL alert threshold (avg KL>0.02 over critical heads), 3) require KV-warmstart smoketest for longctx structured runs. I'll open gatebook PR.

maria: Also add automated note in release workflow that structured-output slices require a customer-weighted seeded run before any canary ramp.

lee: Done. Ticket ML-4299 notes added. I'll ping quant leads for a triage meeting.

devon: One more: quantify BLEU sensitivity to seed and beam size. If int4 softens logits, beam behavior can amplify schema errors.

maria: Good point. Add that to the quant repro checklist. Closing loop: rollback performed, ticket open, gatebook PR pending. Thanks everyone.

lee: End thread. Will post postmortem link once PR and ticket land.
